page: Microsoft Azure L32s_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the LSv3 family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz, with 16 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It includes 8008 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng scores of 1900.09 and 31084.54 respectively. The memory subsystem demonstrates strong performance, highlighted by a Passmark memory score in the top 25% and a cached read-only small block bandwidth of 1680.1 GB/sec. Large block uncached read and write bandwidths reach 149.6 GB/sec and 69.06 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the server achieves a strong text generation speed of 292.02 tokens/sec on a small 135M LLM model, though performance drops to a poor 2.27 tokens/sec on a large 70B model due to the lack of GPU acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the L32s_v3 offers a high density of local storage and memory relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for data-intensive workloads without the premium cost of GPU-accelerated hardware. The combination of 8008 GB of local storage and 256 GB of RAM makes this server well-suited for large-scale databases, big data analytics, caching layers like Redis, and high-throughput web serving.
description: Microsoft Azure L32s_v3 is a storage and memory-optimized server from the LSv3 family, featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs on an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM and a substantial 8008 GB of local storage, supporting Premium Storage. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, the server delivers strong memory performance, as evidenced by its top-25% Passmark memory score and 1680.1 GB/sec cached read bandwidth. While CPU performance is average, with a multi-core stress-ng score of 31084.54, the high local storage capacity and memory density provide excellent qualitative cost efficiency for data-heavy operations. This server is highly suited for large databases, high-throughput web serving, and memory-intensive caching applications.
